description: The chart illustrates the performance of two LLaMA models, LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B, on the ColeG-E task under different SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) conditions. The horizontal axis represents the two models, while the vertical axis is labeled "ColeG-E (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50 in intervals of 10. Each model is associated with a group of four bars, representing different SFT conditions: no SFT (blue), + SFT on D0 (yellow), + SFT on D0, D1 (purple), and + SFT on D0, D1, D2 (red). For LLaMA-2-13B, the bars have approximate values of 7%, 20%, 27%, and 38%, respectively. For LLaMA-2-70B, the corresponding values are around 27%, 45%, 48%, and 50%. The bars within each group are not sorted, but the groups are distinct and clearly labeled. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar, but the legend provides clear color coding for each SFT condition.
